description: WebAuthn challenge record used in the authentication registration and assertion ceremonies. Per ADR-2605260000, this record supports the platform-authenticator flow (FaceID/TouchID/Windows Hello) for Trust Level 1 attestation. The challenge is generated by the auth server and stored temporarily on the MST; the client receives it, presents it to the platform authenticator, and returns a signed attestation. Per W3C WebAuthn spec (Level 3, as of 2026-05-21), the challenge must be at least 32 bytes of cryptographically random data.

challengeId.description: Unique nonce/identifier for this challenge. Format: TID (Timestamp ID) auto-generated by MST. Used by client to correlate challenge fetch with attestation submission.

challenge.description: Base64url-encoded random challenge bytes (≥32 bytes per W3C WebAuthn spec). Generated by the auth server via secure CSPRNG. The client MUST NOT inspect or modify this value; it is passed opaquely to navigator.credentials.get/create.

rpId.description: Relying Party ID. Per ADR-2605260000, this is 'etzhayyim.com'. Must match the origin's effective domain for Web authentication to succeed.

rpOrigin.description: Relying Party origin URI. Per ADR-2605260000, this is 'https://authn.etzhayyim.com' (or equivalent subdomain). Used by authenticator to verify origin before creating/asserting credential.

userVerification.description: User verification requirement. Per ADR-2605260000, Trust Level 1 and 2 both use 'required' (FaceID/TouchID/Windows Hello, or fallback PIN). If user lacks a platform authenticator, the challenge is rejected.

residentKeyRequirement.description: Resident key (discoverable credential) requirement. Per ADR-2605260000 and W3C WebAuthn, 'required' means the authenticator MUST store the credential locally (for passwordless sign-in). Defaults to 'required' for platform authenticators.

timeout.description: Timeout in milliseconds for the authenticator to complete the ceremony (W3C default: 60000 = 60 sec). Verifier should reject challenges older than this window.

createdAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the challenge was generated. Verifier uses this to enforce timeout: reject if (now - createdAt) > timeout.

expiresAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of challenge expiry (createdAt + timeout milliseconds converted to seconds). For convenience; verifier should prefer computing expiresAt from createdAt and timeout.

tag.description: Optional tag to categorize the challenge purpose. Example: 'registration', 'assertion', 'recovery'. Useful for logging and debugging.
